title: Tecnico leva demonstracoes tecnologicas e spin-offs a Web Summit 2026
publisher: Instituto Superior Tecnico, Universidade de Lisboa
what_it_says: Tecnico's news item (in Portuguese): its stand at Web Summit 2026 (Pavilion 2, E272, 10 to 12 November) brings six spin-offs: Acubic, Keel, Opsivision.ai, RTBEAMTECH, RipeNew and Testwaves.
